writeup: Janeke's Italian-made Naturalia squared paddle brush is $25.99 new on Woot, with three left at last check and a three-per-customer limit. The beech-wood rectangular brush with soft moulded tips matches the Janeke SP94N Naturalia square brush. Fresh Beauty Co. lists the same Naturalia Squared Brush for $54.60 in stock, so this is about 52% below that live price.
